title: Monday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time
summary: In Revelation, the risen Christ praises the Church in Ephesus for its hard work and endurance but calls it to repent and recover the love it had at first. In the Gospel, a blind beggar keeps crying out to Jesus despite the crowd, receives his sight, and follows him joyfully. That beggar shows us the eager, persistent love our Lord longs to rekindle in us.
